typography.font_install_instructions: Add Google Fonts imports for 'Cormorant Garamond' (weights 400,600,700) and 'Outfit' (weights 300,400,500,600).

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.overline: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-secondary

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24 for generous breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE A: TETRIS GRID for Home page missions showcase. MODE B: CONTROL ROOM for Dashboard. Mobile-first grid-cols-1.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons.

components_strategy.navigation: Sticky crystal glass header: `fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-border/40`. Include 'Donate Now' CTA (orange) and language toggle (EN/HI).
components_strategy.buttons: Primary (Blue) for standard actions, Secondary (Orange) for 'Donate' / high-impact actions. Use hover effects: `hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-transform duration-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md`.
components_strategy.forms: Use Shadcn UI (Inputs, Textarea, Select, Labels). Generous padding, clean labels. Include `data-testid` on all inputs and submit buttons.
components_strategy.cards: Subtle Neumorphic/Flat style. Background `#FFFFFF`, border `1px solid #E5E5E4`, shadow `shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow`. Padding `p-6` or `p-8`.
components_strategy.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee` for a slow, elegant editorial ribbon showing Mission names (e.g., '✦ MISSION SHAKTI ✦ MISSION ROSHNI ✦ ...') across the screen with a light sand background.
components_strategy.hero_overlay: Gradient overlay on hero image: `bg-gradient-to-b from-black/60 via-black/40 to-transparent` to ensure text readability.

animations.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward motion (`initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}`).
animations.scroll_effects: Use lenis for smooth scrolling globally. Stagger children in grids.

pages_and_routes.name: Home
pages_and_routes.description: Hero section with background image, Marquee with missions, 7 Missions Bento Grid, Call to action for Volunteering & Donating.

pages_and_routes.name: About Us
pages_and_routes.description: NGO Story, Vision, Legal Section 8 details. Use lots of text spacing and images of volunteers.

pages_and_routes.name: Missions
pages_and_routes.description: Grid of all 7 missions. Each linking to a detailed individual mission view.

pages_and_routes.name: Donate
pages_and_routes.description: High-trust donation page. Form to select amounts, fields for PAN/80G, and a mock Razorpay integration section.

pages_and_routes.name: Volunteer
pages_and_routes.description: Registration form to join drives (Blood donation, Langar) and support missions.

pages_and_routes.name: Contact
pages_and_routes.description: Contact info, address, Query form with a dropdown selecting the specific Mission.

pages_and_routes.name: Login / Dashboard
pages_and_routes.description: Clean auth page leading to a Dashboard showing user's donation history or certificates.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use white text on the primary blue and secondary orange.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, dropdowns) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='donate-submit-btn'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling based on the provided color palette.
Use Shadcn UI for structured components like forms, inputs, select dropdowns, and dialogs. Customize them to fit the border-radius and colors specified.
For the hero background, use the `hero_main` image and apply a dark overlay to ensure the white `Cormorant Garamond` heading is perfectly readable.
Build the 7 missions section on the Home page using a Bento grid (Tetris grid) with overlapping elements.
Create the Hindi language version toggle visually (can mock the logic, but the UI must exist in the header).
Add Razorpay logo securely on the Donate page to build trust.
Create placeholders/mock functionalities for the user dashboard.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Strictly use the specified fonts.
